hero.title: An intimate Cantonese and Chiu Chow dining journey.

experience.title: Dining Experience
experience.description: At Tai Zi Hui, every course is crafted with seasonal ingredients and Cantonese technique. From intimate private dining to chef-led tasting menus, we create evenings that feel personal, refined, and memorable.

experiencesShowcase.roomDescription: Our private space is designed to provide a intimate and comfortable dining experience. It is equipped with a private dining area, a private bar, and a private restroom. It is the perfect place for a private dinner or a business meeting.
